assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Restoring the rubric test in _delivered_status stores the partial design review ready, so record["status"] is not INCOMPLETE_STATUS and the assertion reddens; confirmed by logs/negative-control.log.

Over-broadening the mark so that a report answering every design item is also marked incomplete makes record["status"] DEFAULT_STATUS fail and _gate return a refusal; the report's lines come from PLAN_DESIGN_REVIEW_ITEMS, so the assertion tests the parse, not the item list.
_gate(repo) is None reddens if the gate starts refusing a stored review that carries an absent item but no mark; the absent_items comparison takes its two sides from the same literal.
With the rubric narrowing restored the answer is not recorded on the incomplete design review, so record["status"] defaults to ready and the assertion reddens; confirmed by logs/negative-control.log.

findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion compares record["absent_items"] against the same literal the test passed into store_plan_review at line 116, so it holds whatever the store does with its input; the load-bearing assertion for that case is _gate(repo) is None at line 121.
